create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance to start measuring elapsed time for a code block
tic_start_timer: call tic on a Timer to record the start time before a timed operation
toc_stop_timer: call toc on a Timer to stop and return the average elapsed time across calls
toc_get_last_diff: call toc with average=False to get the last individual elapsed time instead of the average
reset_timer: call reset on a Timer to clear all accumulated timing statistics and start fresh
